quantifier_order: Choose sigma from sign C before D, alpha or q.
Choose actual local common values, square-normalize to p^alpha_p*u_p.
Set E_p=sigma*product_{r in S without p} r^alpha_r.
Set k_2=3 and k_p=1 at odd p; n_p=(u_p/E_p).appr(k_p).
CRT gives fixed unit class r modulo M=product p^k_p.
Dirichlet supplies arbitrarily large prime q in that class.
Large bound N+sum S excludes q from S.
All such primes preserve both norms at each p in S; separate compatibility proves the exceptional-q splitting.
residue_freedom: One explicit approximation residue is chosen inside the required squareclass. Different square representatives have the same Legendre sign; signs are not independent CRT control bits.
